antiballplace: Empty registered module in this source snapshot; no behavior is implemented.
armorhud: Shows equipped armor and durability in a movable HUD element.
autotrader: Automatically selects and completes configured villager trades while a merchant screen is open.
autocrystalinfo: Shows AutoCrystal target, damage estimates, timing, and placement information in the HUD.
baritonesettings: Exposes settings for the integrated Baritone pathfinder.
candlehud: Draws a decorative animated candle in the HUD.
chestcounter: Shows a count of nearby chest storage blocks in the HUD.
companion: Draws an animated HUD companion and messages about nearby totem pops and deaths.
cooldowns: Shows attack and hurt cooldown indicators in the HUD.
coords: Shows the player's coordinates in the HUD.
crosshairarrows: Draws arrows around the crosshair pointing toward other players.
clicktp: Attempts to teleport toward a clicked location.
elytra: Changes elytra flight control and movement, with multiple speed and boost modes.
fpscounter: Shows the client's frame rate in the HUD.
gappleshud: Shows golden-apple inventory information in the HUD.
keybinds: Shows enabled module keybinds in the HUD.
killfeed: Shows recent player kills in a HUD feed.
killstats: Shows kills, deaths, kill streak, and kill/death ratio.
legacyhud: Draws a configurable text HUD with client and player status information.
memoryhud: Shows Java memory usage in the HUD.
modulelist: Shows currently enabled modules in the HUD.
nopacketexception: Empty registered module in this source snapshot; no behavior is implemented.
packetcanceler: Can cancel selected outgoing inventory-click and movement packet types.
particles: Draws decorative particles at attack locations.
penisesp: Draws a crude 2D shape over other players' positions.
pinghud: Shows the player's network latency in the HUD.
potionhud: Shows active potion effects in the HUD.
pvpresources: Counts totems, experience bottles, end crystals, and enchanted golden apples in inventory.
radarrewrite: Draws a circular player radar and compass in the HUD.
radar: Draws directional indicators for nearby entities.
rearview: Shows a picture-in-picture view behind the player.
refill: Refills the hotbar with healing items.
serverhelper: Automates server-specific chat commands and notifications, including teleport, auction, and event helpers.
speedometer: Shows movement speed in the HUD.
staffboard: Shows detected server staff and possible vanished staff in a HUD list.
stashlogger: Records loaded chunks with configured numbers of chests or shulker boxes.
targethud: Shows information about the current combat target in the HUD.
timerindicator: Shows the Timer module's current state in the HUD.
totemcounter: Shows available totems and observed totem pops in the HUD.
tpscounter: Shows estimated server ticks per second in the HUD.
tridentboost: Changes Riptide trident launch timing and motion, including a client-side any-weather option.
unhook: Temporarily hides the client by disabling modules and clearing client traces, then restores them on disable.
watermark: Draws the client's branding and status watermark in the HUD.
windows: Opens a client window manager for macros, configurations, friends, waypoints, and proxies.
worldtweaks: Changes client-side fog and time of day; server time packets can be ignored locally.
